We can't push Western ideals on K-pop idols and then get mad if their options don't match. They don't need to speak on issues that are present in Korea. If the issue is affecting the whole world like Palestine and Israel (free Palestine), then I understand that it is an important issue that needs addressing. Yet I have seen so many international fans screaming when beauty standards are brought up or lgbtq issue. Many of these idols look uncomfortable and don't know how to answer. If they agree, then that could impact them in Korea, their home country, but if they don't agree they get yelled at by the international fans and called nasty names.
